data.name: Virat
data.gender_notes: Virat is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vira' meaning 'hero' or 'brave'. It signifies strength, valor and courage. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is also known as Virat, the cosmic man, symbolizing the infinite universe. The name Virat carries the meaning “Hero, Valiant, Brave” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Virat usually hope their child will grow to embody hero, valiant, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine hero within, the inner strength and courage to overcome challenges and obstacles in life.
data.etymology: Virat belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Hero, Valiant, Brave.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Virat total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_sanskrit.name: वीरत
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: वीरत् (Vīrat) is derived from the Sanskrit word वीर (vīr), meaning manly, heroic, brave, and त (t), a grammatical suffix denoting the present participle or the masculine gender. Thus, Virat means hero, valiant, brave.

in_hindi.name: वीरत

in_hindi.long_meaning: वीरत का नाम संस्कृत स्वरूप से हिंदी में परिचित है। यह वीर (वीर) हिंदू दharmशास्त्र में एक अधिक मानवीक और धर्मनिरत शब्द है, जो वीरत को वालियान, बराबर और धर्मनिरत बताता है। वीरत के नाम का संदर्भित मतलब वीरत को अपनी वीरता है, जो उसके साथ उसका समझ बनाने के लिए उसे वीरता कहते हैं।
